subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the Control UI Sessions list adopt mailbox-style last-message previews now, and should maintainers repair the existing open PR or replace it with a narrower implementation?
rationale: Current main has the backend capability but the UI behavior is still absent, and the open linked PR plus product-decision labels mean automation should not create a parallel implementation without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair or replace the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 as the implementation candidate if it can be narrowed to lastMessagePreview, current paths, tests, and real UI proof; otherwise replace it with an equivalent focused branch.

options.title: Fold into broader sessions overview
options.body: Defer this narrow preview request into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one larger Sessions workspace design instead of incremental list polish.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the current Sessions table unchanged until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the UX direction and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 as the implementation candidate if it can be narrowed to lastMessagePreview, current paths, tests, and real UI proof; otherwise replace it with an equivalent focused branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the most concentrated work across the Sessions UI and gateway session-list surfaces involved in this decision.
